title: Packaging, Storage, Sampling, and Release Review Workbook
purpose: Provide release-oriented records for package qualification, storage stability, aW instrument control, representative sampling, COA interpretation, deviations, and CAPA.

sections.title: Packaging Qualification Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the complete package system protect the real product under intended storage and transport conditions?

sections.title: Storage Stability Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Which storage variable best explains observed quality change over time?

sections.title: Water-Activity Instrument Control Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Are instrument and sample controls strong enough for the aW result to support release decisions?

sections.title: Product Sampling and COA Interpretation Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the sample design support inference about the whole batch, and are COA limits interpreted with method uncertainty?

sections.title: Postharvest Deviation and Release Review
sections.decisionPrompt: Has the deviation been contained, investigated, and resolved with enough evidence for an authorized disposition?

qualityRules: Qualify the whole package system, not material specifications alone.
Retain storage excursions and raw stability data.
Treat sampling design as part of analytical validity.
Do not release material until deviation, uncertainty, and CAPA decisions are documented.
